mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT checkin_date) FROM checkin_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND checkin_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND checkin_date <= CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT checkin_date) FROM checkin_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(checkin_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT checkin_date) FROM checkin_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND YEAR(checkin_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN checkin_type = 2 THEN user_id END) AS audioUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN checkin_type = 1 THEN user_id END) AS readUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN checkin_type = 3 THEN user_id END) AS noteUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS totalUsers FROM checkin_record WHERE circle_id = #{circleId} AND checkin_date = CURDATE() AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT group_id) FROM checkin_record WHERE circle_id = #{circleId} AND checkin_date = CURDATE() AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND group_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT r.group_id AS groupId, g.name AS groupName, COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) AS activeUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id, r.checkin_date) AS totalCheckins FROM checkin_record r LEFT JOIN t_group g ON r.group_id = g.id WHERE r.circle_id = #{circleId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.group_id IS NOT NULL AND r.checkin_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) GROUP BY r.group_id, g.name ORDER BY totalCheckins DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT checkin_date AS checkinDate, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS checkinUsers FROM checkin_record WHERE circle_id = #{circleId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND checkin_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY checkin_date ORDER BY checkin_date
